camel_example: aliyun sas DescribeMatchedMaliciousNames --region cn-hangzhou --Levels serious --Lang zh
description_en: Queries the list of malicious file types
description_zh: 查询恶意文件类型列表
kebab_example: aliyun sas describe-matched-malicious-names --levels serious --lang zh --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeMatchedMaliciousNames

parameters.help_en:
The risk levels of the malicious samples in images to query. You can specify multiple values. Separate multiple values with commas (,). Valid values:
serious: urgent
suspicious: suspicious
remind: reminder
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的镜像恶意样本的危险程度。可输入多个值，多个值之间使用英文逗号（,）分隔。取值：
serious：紧急
suspicious：可疑
remind：提醒
parameters.name: levels

parameters.help_en:
The language type for the request and response messages. Default value: zh. Valid values:

zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为zh。取值：

zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

Count.description_en: The number of entries returned on the current page in a paged query. If paging is not used, this value indicates the total number of entries
Count.description_zh: 分页查询时，当前页显示的数据条数

DisplayName.description_en: The display name of the malicious sample type
DisplayName.description_zh: 恶意样本类型显示名称

Key.description_en: The key of the malicious sample type

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. Alibaba Cloud generates a unique identifier for each request. You can use the ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
